Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Shambhu Narayan Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Suraj Kumar Tiwari, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Nawal Kishore Prasad, APP
For the Informant : Mr. Rakesh Mohan Singh, Adv.
CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA
ORAL ORDER 2 14-12-2023 1. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned APP for the State along with learned counsel for the O.P. No.2.
2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is cousin father-in-law of the O.P No.2 and he has been implicated in the present case based on a general and omnibus allegation.
It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner.
The learned counsel further submits that petitioner is an Assistant Manager, posted with the Central Bank of India, presently at Balia, U.P.

It is next submitted that petitioner is separate in mess Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.56764 of 2023(2) dt.14-12-2023 and property from the husband of the O.P. No.2 but he has been implicated only to coerce the husband into submission.
3.
The learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No.2 seeks an adjournment.
